Nagigation Controls:

Left Mouse: Rotate
Middle Mouse: Zoom
Shift + Left Mouse: Pan

Basic animations:

W : Move front legs forward
S : Move back legs backward
A : Tilt head left
D : Tild head right
Arrow Keys : Translate frog
Shift + Arrow Keys : Rotate frog

Bonus animations:

X : Swim
J : Jump

Extra features:

L : Mouth open/close
G : Toggle ground visibility
Shift + W : Reverse movement of front legs
R : Reset all commands
